title: Kodiak 2026 — RD course notes
publisher: HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB
claims: The race director's course notes say the Sugarloaf Aid Station for the 100M and 100K will be relocated 0.5 miles from its original location because of a sensitive species in the area.
The notes say the 100K overall cut-off has been extended to 02:15 on Sunday, 11 October, because of an increase in mileage of about one mile.
The notes say the Cactus Flats crew location has been removed, with no crew or pacers allowed at Cactus Flats.
The notes say the final descent now comes down the Going Green trail after the top of Snow Summit, where it previously came down Knickerbocker (2N08).
The notes say a new hydration station called Grandview has been added.

verification.note: 2026-11-09 通过 WebFetch 直接读取官方 RD Course Notes 页全文。页面未标发布日期，内容以 2026 届（10 月 11 日为周日）为准。

claimVerification.note: 原文：Due to a sensitive species in the area, the Sugarloaf Aid Station (100M & 100K) will be relocated 0.5 miles from the original location.
原文：The 100K overall race cutoff time has been extended to 2:15AM Sunday, Oct 11 due to an increase in mileage (approx. 1 mile).
原文：Cactus Flats crew location has been removed. No crew or pacers at Cactus Flats.
原文：Finish: the final descent now comes down Going Green trail after the top of Snow Summit (previously Knickerbocker, 2N08 if you ran the race before).
原文：New this year: we've added a hydration station (called Grandview).
